pr_title: bulkio: Fix backup tpcc roachtest failure.
pr_body:
Fixes #53728
Fixes #53591

Add a `--deprecated-fk-indexes` flag to workload command when running
at version below 20.2.

Release Notes: None
Release Justification: release blocking roachtest fix.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/53798)
